title: [ v2.1 ] Unity 기반 모바일 게임 CI/CD 파이프라인 (, Jenkins + Firebase + Slack)
markdown:
> ✏️ > > > > 이 문서는 EC2 위에 Docker 기반으로 Jenkins, Nginx, Certbot을 구성하고, Unity CLI 빌드 → Firebase App Distribution 배포 → Slack 알림까지 자동화하는 실전형 파이프라인 구축 가이드이다. ### 📐 아키텍처 ```yaml [ GitHub Push ] → Webhook → Nginx (443/80) → Jenkins (Docker, HTTPS) → Unity 빌드 → Firebase 배포 → Slack 알림 ``` ### 📁 디렉토리 구조 ```bash infra/ ├── docker-compose.yml ├── .env ├── jenkins/ │ └── jenkins_home/ ├── nginx/ │ ├── nginx.conf │ ├── ssl/ │ └── healthcheck.conf ├── certbot/ │ └── init-letsencrypt.sh scripts/ ├── build.sh ├── deploy.sh ├── notify.sh unity-project/ └── BuildScript.cs ``` ## 🧩 Jenkinsfile 예시 ```yaml pipeline { agent any environment { SLACK_CHANNEL = "#cicd" UNITY_PROJECT_PATH = "unity-project" BUILD_OUTPUT_PATH = "build/output.apk" FIREBASE_APP_ID = credentials('firebase_app_id') FIREBASE_TOKEN = credentials('firebase_token') SLACK_WEBHOOK = credentials('slack_webhook') } triggers { githubPush() } stages { stage('Checkout') { steps { git url: 'https://github.com/your-org/unity-game-repo.git', branch: 'main' } } stage('Unity Build') { steps { sh "chmod +x ./scripts/build.sh" sh "./scripts/build.sh $UNITY_PROJECT_PATH" } } stage('Distribute to Firebase') { steps { sh "chmod +x ./scripts/deploy.sh" sh "./scripts/deploy.sh $FIREBASE_APP_ID $BUILD_OUTPUT_PATH $FIREBASE_TOKEN" } } } post { success { sh "scripts/notify.sh success" } failure { sh "scripts/notify.sh failure" } } } ```
build.sh ```shell #!/bin/bash UNITY_PATH="/opt/Unity/Editor/Unity" PROJECT_PATH=$1 BUILD_PATH="build/output.apk" BUILD_TARGET="Android" BUILD_METHOD="BuildScript.BuildAndroid" $UNITY_PATH \ -batchmode \ -nographics \ -silent-crashes \ -logFile /dev/stdout \ -projectPath "$PROJECT_PATH" \ -executeMethod "$BUILD_METHOD" \ -buildTarget "$BUILD_TARGET" \ -quit echo "✅ Unity Build 완료: $BUILD_PATH" ```
deploy.sh ```shell #!/bin/bash FIREBASE_APP_ID=$1 APK_PATH=$2 TOKEN=$3 firebase appdistribution:distribute "$APK_PATH" \ --app "$FIREBASE_APP_ID" \ --token "$TOKEN" \ --groups "testers" ```
notify.sh ```shell #!/bin/bash STATUS=$1 WEBHOOK=$(cat /run/secrets/slack_webhook) if [ "$STATUS" = "success" ]; then COLOR="#36a64f" TEXT="✅ Unity Build & Deploy 성공" else COLOR="#ff0000" TEXT="❌ Unity Build or Deploy 실패" fi curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' --data "{ \"attachments\": [{ \"color\": \"$COLOR\", \"text\": \"$TEXT\" }] }" "$WEBHOOK" ```
BuildScript.cs ```shell using UnityEditor; using System.IO; public class BuildScript { public static void BuildAndroid() { string path = "build/output.apk"; BuildPipeline.BuildPlayer( new[] { "Assets/Scenes/MainScene.unity" }, path, BuildTarget.Android, BuildOptions.None ); Debug.Log("✅ Android APK 생성 완료: " + path); } } ```
### 🔐 Jenkins Credentials 설정 ```shell firebase_app_id: Secret Text, Firebase App ID firebase_token: Secret Text, Firebase CLI 로그인 토큰 slack_webhook: Secret Text, Slack Webhook URL ``` ### ✅ 실행 절차 요약 1. .env 작성 1. init-letsencrypt.sh 실행 → 인증서 발급 1. docker-compose up -d 1. Jenkins 접속 → 플러그인 설치 (GitHub, Slack) 1. Jenkinsfile → GitHub Push → 자동 빌드 실행 ### 🛠️ 실무 기준 보완 사항 Jenkins 8080 포트 외부 비공개, Nginx만 노출 인증서 자동 갱신 → certbot + reload Slack Webhook은 Jenkins Credentials에 저장 Firebase CLI 인증은 토큰 기반 Unity headless CLI 빌드 자동화 ### 📚 참고 링크 Unity CLI: https://docs.unity3d.com/Manual/CommandLineArguments.html Firebase App Distribution: https://firebase.google.com/docs/app-distribution Jenkins Slack Plugin: https://plugins.jenkins.io/slack/ GameCI: https://game.ci/
